confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on a few web-search snippets from cost-of-living indexes and travel guides dated 2025-2026. These are partly stale and conflicting (cappuccino about $2.20-$6, domestic beer about $1.50-$5). Wine rests on a single cafe menu, cross-checked against the beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not taken from search results or live listings, and are nudged up for the July dry-season peak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink reasoned from Victoria Falls-specific snippets, with Zimbabwe national averages as a lower reference point; tourist prices are generally quoted in USD. Accommodation reasoned from general knowledge of comparable falls-side tourist towns such as Livingstone, Zambia.
